name: orb_5min_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: The 5-minute opening range (high and low of 09:15-09:20) captures the initial price discovery auction. Breakout above/below this range with volume confirmation signals institutional direction for the session. The 5-min ORB is the fastest variant — it works best on high-conviction gap days where institutions have clear directional intent from pre-open orders. The inefficiency exists because most retail traders are still deciding whether to trade during the first 5 minutes, missing the institutional flow signal. The 5-min range is narrow enough that false breakouts are frequent (~55% fail), so the edge comes entirely from asymmetric payoffs: winners run 2x+ losers.
stock_filter: daily avg volume > ₹200cr; today's gap > 0.2% (some directional energy at open)
indicators: ORB_range_vs_ATR = ORB_range / (ATR_14_daily / 6.5)  # normalized by per-hour ATR

conditions: close > vwap (above VWAP for additional confirmation)
long.confirmation: breakout bar closes in upper 30% of its range with volume > 1.5x avg

short.confirmation: breakdown bar closes in lower 30% of its range with volume > 1.5x avg

entry.entry_price: market order on confirmed breakout bar close

exit.stop_loss: close re-enters ORB range (crosses below ORB_high for longs, above ORB_low for shorts) OR midpoint of ORB range
exit.trailing_stop: after 1.0 * ORB_range gain, trail at ORB_high (longs) or ORB_low (shorts)
exit.time_stop: exit if held > 120 mins without 60% of target reached
exit.eod_rule: flatten by 14:00 IST (early — 5-min ORB momentum fades by afternoon)
exit.signal_exit: if NIFTY reverses > 0.5% against trade direction, exit (macro headwind)

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX between 12 and 22 (need vol for breakout but not chaos)
filters.time_filter: enter between 09:20-09:45 IST; breakout must occur within 25 mins of range formation
filters.trend_filter: NIFTY 50 not limit-down or circuit-breaker; gap direction aligned with breakout preferred
filters.event_filter: skip on F&O expiry day; skip if stock has earnings today
other_filters: skip if ORB_range > 2 * average ORB_range (already too volatile, exhaustion likely)

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — ORB is well-known but 5-min variant with volume filter remains effective due to execution speed required

weaknesses: The 5-minute range is very narrow (often 0.2-0.4%), making it susceptible to noise-driven false breakouts; win rate is below 50%
On low-gap days (<0.2%), the 5-min range is compressed and nearly any price movement triggers a breakout, most of which fail
The strategy requires very fast execution (within seconds of breakout) to avoid slippage; delayed entry significantly reduces the reward-to-risk ratio
prior_art: Crabel (1990) 'Day Trading with Short-Term Price Patterns'; Fisher (2002) 5-min ORB. Indian market ORB studies by Choudhary & Saini (2015).
notes: Edge math: 0.48 * 65bps - 0.52 * 25bps = 31.2 - 13 = 18.2bps gross. Costs ~9bps RT. Net ~9.2bps/trade * 2 trades = ~18.4bps daily. The sub-50% win rate makes this psychologically challenging but the 1.8:1 winner-to-loser ratio compensates. Discipline on stop losses is non-negotiable.
